name: hartwell-supply
description: Hartwell Supply, a fictional neighbourhood hardware store that accepts Earmark gifts.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,yellow "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
